entries.name: Adam Randall
entries.summary: Randall (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against Carolina.

entries.name: Audric Estime
entries.summary: Estime (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Bears.

entries.name: Brandon Aiyuk
entries.summary: Aiyuk's agent, Drew Rosenhaus, said Tuesday that the receiver is "100 percent healthy" and fully recovered from his November 2024 right knee surgery and plans to work out for interested teams once he's released by the 49ers, Dianna Russini of BetUS TV reports.

entries.name: Carson Beck
entries.summary: Beck (back) has been ruled out for Sunday's game at Kansas City, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

entries.name: Case Keenum
entries.summary: Keenum (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as Chicago's emergency third quarterback Sunday versus the Saints.

entries.name: Dalton Kincaid
entries.summary: Kincaid (thumb/ankle) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Dolphins, Cameron Wolfe of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Drake Maye
entries.summary: Maye, who sustained a fractured right fibula in last Sunday's loss to the Lions, is on track to miss at least six weeks, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Drew Allar
entries.summary: inactive

entries.name: Easton Stick
entries.summary: Stick (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the emergency third quarterback against the Lions, Scott Smith of the Buccaneers' official site reports.

entries.name: Eli Heidenreich
entries.summary: inactive

entries.name: Elijah Sarratt
entries.summary: Sarratt (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against Carolina.

entries.name: Garrett Nussmeier
entries.summary: Nussmeier (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Chiefs' emergency third quarterback against the Cardinals on Sunday.

entries.name: Isaac Guerendo
entries.summary: Guerendo (pectoral) was working off to the side during practice Thursday, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Isaiah Williams
entries.summary: Williams (ribs) won't play in Sunday's game against the Chargers.

entries.name: Ja'Tavion Sanders
entries.summary: Sanders (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against Baltimore, Darin Gantt of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Jake Ferguson
entries.summary: inactive

entries.name: Jared Wayne
entries.summary: inactive

entries.name: Jonathan Mingo
entries.summary: inactive

entries.name: Jordan Addison
entries.summary: Head coach Kevin O'Connell said Wednesday that Addison underwent thumb surgery earlier this week and won't be placed on injured reserve, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Josh Jacobs
entries.summary: Jacobs (finger) is practicing Sunday, Mike Spofford of the Packers' official site reports.

entries.name: Justin Joly
entries.summary: inactive

entries.name: Kaden Wetjen
entries.summary: Wetjen (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Eagles.

entries.name: Kedon Slovis
entries.summary: Slovis (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Panthers but will serve as the Ravens' emergency quarterback.

entries.name: Kenneth Walker III
entries.summary: inactive

entries.name: Kyler Murray
entries.summary: Murray (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday night's game against the 49ers.

entries.name: Luke Musgrave
entries.summary: Packers head coach Matt LaFleur said Saturday that he doesn't anticipate Musgrove (neck) returning from the PUP list this season, according to NFL reporter Jason B. Hirschhorn.

entries.name: Marvin Harrison Jr.
entries.summary: inactive

entries.name: Nicholas Singleton
entries.summary: Singleton (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Cowboys.

entries.name: Omar Cooper Jr.
entries.summary: Coach Aaron Glenn said Friday that Cooper (ankle/hip) will be out for Sunday's game against the Chargers, Brian Costello of the New York Post reports.

entries.name: Riley Leonard
entries.summary: The Colts announced Friday that Leonard will act as Anthony Richardson's backup at quarterback, Stephen Holder of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Sam Darnold
entries.summary: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that he's "really optimistic" Darnold (quadriceps/ribs) will be able to get a full week's worth of practice coming out of the Seahawks' Week 11 bye and start their next game Sunday, Nov. 29, against the 49ers, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Skyler Bell
entries.summary: Bell (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Dolphins.

entries.name: Will Howard
entries.summary: Howard (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Steelers' emergency quarterback against the Eagles on Sunday.

entries.name: Will Mallory
entries.summary: inactive

entries.name: Woody Marks
entries.summary: inactive

entries.name: Zachariah Branch
entries.summary: out

entries.name: A.J. Brown
entries.summary: Brown (hamstring) is expected to miss multiple weeks, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Brenen Thompson
entries.summary: Thompson (hamstring) is listed as doubtful for Sunday's game against the Jets.

entries.name: Bo Melton
entries.summary: Melton (thigh) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Vikings, Rob Demovsky of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Brock Bowers
entries.summary: Adam Schefter of ESPN reported on Sunday NFL Countdown that "there is not a lot of optimism" that Bowers (ankle/quadriceps) will suit up Sunday at Denver, but the tight end is "pushing to play."

entries.name: Charlie Kolar
entries.summary: Kolar (concussion) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Jets.

entries.name: George Holani
entries.summary: Holani is week-to-week after suffering an MCL sprain in Sunday's win over Las Vegas, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reported Monday.

entries.name: Jordan James
entries.summary: James (calf) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Vikings in Mexico City.

entries.name: Kayshon Boutte
entries.summary: Boutte's hip injury he suffered in Thursday night's win over the Colts doesn't appear to be serious, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

entries.name: Kyren Williams
entries.summary: Head coach Sean McVay said Saturday that Williams is tending to a sore toe but is expected to play Wednesday against the Packers, Sarah Barshop of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Ladd McConkey
entries.summary: McConkey (back) is expected to play in Sunday's game against the Jets, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Mac Jones
entries.summary: Jones (illness) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Vikings in Mexico City.

entries.name: Mike Evans
entries.summary: Evans (Achilles), who is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Vikings in Mexico City, is expected to be active and is likely to avoid a strict "pitch count," though the 49ers plan to "be smart" with his workload, Jay Glazer reported on "Fox NFL Sunday."

entries.name: Rachaad White
entries.summary: White (heel) is listed as questionable for Monday's game versus the Bengals.

entries.name: Roschon Johnson
entries.summary: Johnson exited Sunday's game versus the Saints due to an ankle injury.

entries.name: Seth McGowan
entries.summary: McGowan (hamstring) has been ruled out for the rest of Thursday's game against the Texans, Jane Slater of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Skyy Moore
entries.summary: Moore (ankle) participated in practice Saturday, Bill Huber of SI.com reports.

entries.name: Alec Pierce
entries.summary: Pierce's season "is almost certainly over" due to the heel injury that landed the wideout on IR on Sept. 26, according to Ian Rapoport of NFL Network.

entries.name: Andrei Iosivas
entries.summary: Iosivas (thumb) is listed as doubtful for Monday's game against the Commanders.

entries.name: Caleb Lohner
entries.summary: Lohner (foot) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Raiders, Aric DiLalla of the Broncos' official site reports.

entries.name: Christian Kirk
entries.summary: Kirk announced Wednesday via his personal Instagram account that he recently underwent meniscus surgery.

entries.name: Davante Adams
entries.summary: Adams (hamstring) has an "outside chance" to return from injured reserve for the Rams' Week 13 matchup with the Chiefs but is more likely to be activated around mid-December, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: De'Zhaun Stribling
entries.summary: Stribling (ankle) was doing some work on the side at Wednesday's practice, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Dontayvion Wicks
entries.summary: The Eagles placed Wicks (ankle/foot) on injured reserve Saturday.

entries.name: Gardner Minshew II
entries.summary: Minshew (elbow) underwent UCL reconstructive surgery Monday, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Jacory Croskey-Merritt
entries.summary: Croskey-Merritt (groin) is slated to be activated from IR in time to play in Monday's game against the Bengals, Matt Zenitz of CBS Sports reports.

entries.name: Jalen McMillan
entries.summary: Head coach Todd Bowles suggested Monday that McMillan (knee) isn't likely to immediately return to action following the Buccaneers' Week 10 bye, Rick Stroud of the Tampa Bay Times reports.

entries.name: James Conner
entries.summary: Cardinals head coach Mike LaFleur said Wednesday that he has no new updates on the status of Conner (foot), who is still "working to return to perform," Tyler Drake of ArizonaSports.com reports. "It was not a good injury," LaFleur said.

entries.name: Jared Wiley
entries.summary: The Chiefs placed Wiley (ankle) on injured reserve Wednesday, Matt Derrick of ChiefsDigest.com reports.

entries.name: Jonathon Brooks
entries.summary: Brooks (groin) has been downgraded to out for Sunday's game against the Ravens.

entries.name: Lamar Jackson
entries.summary: The Ravens believe "there's a chance" that Jackson (thumb) could return for their Week 16 matchup with the Browns, assuming all goes well in his recovery from right thumb surgery, Dan Graziano of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
entries.summary: Pittman (foot) is not expected to be activated from injured reserve for Sunday's game against the Eagles, Brooke Pryor of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Puka Nacua
entries.summary: Nacua (knee/toe) is expected to be sidelined 4-to-5 months after undergoing surgery Tuesday to repair his right MCL, which means he won't be on track to return at any point during the playoffs, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Terrance Ferguson
entries.summary: Ferguson (hamstring/ankle) isn't ready to return to game action, but the Rams still plan to activate him from injured reserve before Week 12 and keep him on the active roster, Adam Grosbard of The Orange County Register reports.

entries.name: Tyjae Spears
entries.summary: The Titans placed Spears (knee) on injured reserve Saturday, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

entries.name: Tyrone Tracy Jr.
entries.summary: Tracy (hamstring) could be reinstated from injured reserve when first eligible ahead of the Giants' Week 13 game against the 49ers, Dan Duggan of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Wan'Dale Robinson
entries.summary: Coach Robert Saleh said Wednesday that Robinson (ankle) -- who was placed on IR on Tuesady -- is out for the rest of the season, Terry McCormick of TitanInsider.com reports.
